hostd_wire_busy: Error (code hostd.busy): hostd refused the connection because it is overloaded. It is shown in the one toast that folds host failures.
hostd_wire_cli_not_found: The app cannot find the atlas command line program that starts the terminal host (code hostd.cli_not_found). {command} is the installer line for this OS, shown as is; the Windows variant says it runs in PowerShell.
hostd_wire_closed: A call failed because the terminal host (hostd) closed the connection before it answered (code hostd.closed). Technical: hostd is the process name.
hostd_wire_disconnected: A call failed because the connection to the terminal host (hostd) was already gone (code hostd.disconnected). Technical: hostd is the process name.
hostd_wire_events_dropped: Warning toast when the terminal host event stream fell behind and the app re-read the terminals (code hostd.events_dropped).
hostd_wire_feature_agents: Name of what a terminal host without the agents capability lacks, inside the list of hostd_wire_older_features: which agent runs in which tab.
hostd_wire_feature_lsp: Name of what a terminal host without the lsp capability lacks, inside the list of hostd_wire_older_features: completion, hover, go to definition.
hostd_wire_feature_pty_attach_raw: Name of what a terminal host without the pty_attach_raw capability lacks, inside the list of hostd_wire_older_features: the GPU terminal reads a raw byte stream.
hostd_wire_fs_already_exists: Error (code fs.io, kind already_exists): the name is taken, e.g. creating a folder where a file has that name. {path} is the path, shown as is.
hostd_wire_fs_is_a_directory: Error (code fs.io, kind is_a_directory): a file was expected and the path is a folder. {path} is the path, shown as is.
hostd_wire_fs_not_a_directory: Error (code fs.io, kind not_a_directory): the path goes through a file as if it were a folder, e.g. creating a file inside a file. {path} is the path, shown as is.
hostd_wire_fs_not_found: Error (code fs.not_found) when a file or folder a request names does not exist, e.g. deleting a file that is already gone. {path} is that path, shown as is.
hostd_wire_fs_other: Error (code fs.io, kind other): a filesystem failure with no sentence of its own. The system's own words are shown apart, behind the Details button. {path} is the path, shown as is.
hostd_wire_fs_permission_denied: Error (code fs.io, kind permission_denied): the operating system refused access. {path} is the file or folder, shown as is.
hostd_wire_invalid_base64: Error (code hostd.invalid_argument, reason bad_base64): the app sent file or input data that is not base64. {field} is the name of the request field (data, stdin), shown as is.
hostd_wire_invalid_empty: Error (code hostd.invalid_argument, reason empty): the app asked the terminal host to run a command with an empty argument list.
hostd_wire_invalid_no_parent: Error (code hostd.invalid_argument, reason no_parent): a file was to be written at a path that is a filesystem root.
hostd_wire_lsp_crashed_repeated_hint: Hint under the language server reason crashed when it kept crashing.
hostd_wire_lsp_crashed_repeated_message: Language server reason (code crashed, cause repeated): it kept stopping and the restart budget is spent. {server} is the server name.
hostd_wire_lsp_crashed_start_hint: Hint under the language server reason crashed when it failed to start.
hostd_wire_lsp_crashed_start_message: Language server reason (code crashed) when the process could not be started or did not complete its handshake. {server} is the server name, {detail} the error, English, shown as is.
hostd_wire_lsp_custom_not_found_hint: Hint under the language server reason custom_not_found. "The language settings" are Settings > Editor > Languages.
hostd_wire_lsp_custom_not_found_message: Language server reason (code custom_not_found): the command the user set for a language is not an executable. {program} is that command.
hostd_wire_lsp_install_failed_hint: Hint under the language server reason install_failed. "The language settings" are Settings > Editor > Languages.
hostd_wire_lsp_install_failed_message: Language server reason (code install_failed): the install ran and failed. {server} is the server name, {detail} the error, English, shown as is.
hostd_wire_lsp_no_curl_hint: Hint under the language server reason no_curl.
hostd_wire_lsp_no_curl_message: Language server reason (code no_curl): downloads use curl and it is not installed. {server} is the server name.
hostd_wire_lsp_no_go_hint: Hint under the language server reason no_go. {server} is the server name (gopls).
hostd_wire_lsp_no_go_message: Language server reason (code no_go): the server is built with Go and Go is missing. {server} is the server name (gopls).
hostd_wire_lsp_offline_hint: Hint under the language server reason offline.
hostd_wire_lsp_offline_message: Language server reason (code offline): the download failed on the network. {server} is the server name, {detail} the download error, English, shown as is.
hostd_wire_lsp_unsupported_platform_hint: Hint under the language server reason unsupported_platform. "The language settings" are Settings > Editor > Languages.
hostd_wire_lsp_unsupported_platform_mess: Language server reason (code unsupported_platform): no download exists for this OS and CPU. {server} is the server name, {detail} the missing build, English, shown as is.
hostd_wire_older: Why the terminal host (hostd) is not current, when only its version differs (code hostd.older with no lost feature). Shown on the sidebar chip, in the restart prompt, in Settings and in the update card. {version} is the host version, {app_version} the Atlas version.
hostd_wire_older_features: Why the terminal host (hostd) is not current, when features are off until it restarts (code hostd.older). {features} is a list of the feature names hostd_wire_feature_*, joined with the language's "and".
hostd_wire_refused: The terminal host (hostd) answered a request with a refusal instead of its data (code hostd.refused). {why} is its own word for it (unauthorized, hostd busy, too many clients), English, shown as is.
hostd_wire_remote_connecting: A call to a terminal host on another machine came before its connection was up (code hostd.remote_connecting). {host} is the host id (ssh:alias).
hostd_wire_remote_unreachable: A call to a terminal host on another machine failed because its connection is down (code hostd.remote_unreachable). {host} is the host id (ssh:alias), {why} the last connect error, English.
hostd_wire_spawn_not_found: Error (code exec.spawn_failed, reason not_found): the program Atlas tried to run is not installed or not on the PATH. {program} is its name, shown as is. PATH is the environment variable.
hostd_wire_spawn_other: Error (code exec.spawn_failed, reason other): starting the program failed for a reason with no sentence of its own. The system's own words are shown apart, behind the Details button. {program} is its name, shown as is.
hostd_wire_spawn_permission_denied: Error (code exec.spawn_failed, reason permission_denied): the system refused to run the program. {program} is its path or name, shown as is.
hostd_wire_start_failed: The app started the terminal host (hostd) and it never accepted a connection (code hostd.start_failed).
hostd_wire_too_many_clients: Error (code hostd.too_many_clients): hostd refused the connection because it already serves as many clients as it takes.
hostd_wire_unreachable: The local terminal host (hostd) does not answer (code hostd.unreachable). Shown in the one toast that folds every failed call, which has a Restart terminal host button and a Report button next to it.
hostd_wire_unreachable_why: hostd_wire_unreachable plus the last error of the connect loop, redacted and in English, in parentheses ({why}).
hostd_wire_upgrade_failed: The live upgrade of the running terminal host failed (code hostd.upgrade_failed); the terminals stay on the old host. {error} is hostd's answer, English, shown as is.
hostd_wire_upgraded: Toast after the running terminal host was replaced by the version of this app without ending any terminal (code hostd.upgraded).
